Variable names are molecular compositions clustered with the iodide reagent ion as detected by the UW-HRTOF-CIMS.
The reported molecular compositions are certain, though, isomers cannot be resolved.
Mixing ratios are determined using compound-specific sensitivities, thus a chemical identity of compounds had to be assumed.
When possible we applied sensitivities obtained from calibration to a known isomer. 
However, for several compounds, calibration standards are yet unavailable, requiring an estimate of sensitivities.
In many cases, in particular organics, we are most likely sensitive to multiple isomers and cannot resolve their individual contributions to the observed ion signal.
"Approximate calibration": Result from a series of laboratory calibrations 
"Kinetic limit": Upper limit sensitivity obtained from kinetic gas theory and residence time in ion-molecule reaction region 
A calibrated source of isotopically labeled formic acid, H[13C]OOH and was used to correct the sensitivities for organics for each flight, and to assess the variability of sensitivities within a flight.
Possible dependences of sensitivities on humidity have not yet been accounted for. Most organics, though, exhibit a decreasing sensitivity with increasing water vapor pressure, meaning the reported mixing ratios are biased low as the backgrounds are biased high.
Contact Joel Thornton for details.
I(C5H10O3)- (assumed IEPOX or ISOPOOH) Approximate calibration 
I(C5H10O5)- (assumed multiple hydr(per)oxy groups) Estimation of calibration, see also D'Ambro et al. (ACP, 2016) and Liu et al. (EST, 2016)  
I(C5H8O3)- (assumed similar to C5H10O3) Estimation of calibration 
I(C5H9O4N)- (assumed hydroxy-nitrate) Estimation of calibration 
I(C5H9O5N)- (assumed hydroxy-ketone-nitrate) Estimation of calibration 
I(C4H7O5N)- (assumed hydroxy-ketone-nitrate) Estimation of calibration 
I(C4H6O4)- (assumed 3-4 hydr(per)oxy groups) Estimation of calibration 
I(C9H14O4)- (assumed 3-4 hydr(per)oxy groups) Estimation of calibration 
I(C8H12O5)- (assumed 3-4 hydr(per)oxy groups) Estimation of calibration 
I(SO2)- (sulfur dioxide) Calibration from gas cylinder 
I(HNO3)- (nitric acid) Calibration relative to formic acid, following Lee et al. (EST, 2014, dx.doi.org/10.1021/es500362a) 
I(H2SO4)- (sulfuric acid) Kinetic limit. Ions detected as HSO4- (assumed proton transfer from H2SO4 to I-) were considered as well.
